records.question: Across all years of PMAY-G data, how many houses in South West Khasi Hills district are completed?
records.rewritten: How many PMAY-G houses were completed in South West Khasi Hills district across all years?
records.sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(lgd_district) AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay
WHERE
  UPPER(lgd_district) = ANY(
    ARRAY['SOUTH WEST KHASI HILLS']
  )
GROUP BY
  UPPER(lgd_district)
records.answer: Completed houses in South West Khasi Hills, across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): 7,100. This is the PMAY-G figure across all financial years.
